report.summary: Local server: the content-only page, a record-shaped data snapshot, a live event stream, 127.0.0.1 binding, a Host allow-list and Origin check with no CORS, a read-only (query_only=1) database opener and the network-path guard. Spec gate passed at revision 2 (round 1 CHANGES-REQUIRED, round 2 APPROVE-WITH-NOTES, both notes applied). Code review round 1 NO-GO (1 High, 3 Medium, 7 Low, 1 Informational), all fixed test-first; round 2 GO with 3 Low and 1 Informational as follow-ups. Canonical run 334/99/261 PASS bound to 270f2de after rebase onto main a23afd8.

events.detail: standard, ceiling assisted -> assisted; ratified earned lift supervised

blocked-area breaker: PBI-005 granted exporters/board_config.py in allowed_areas while blocked_areas held exporters/**, and a blocked match wins (scope_guard.py:177-185). Both spec-gate rounds read the grant and called scope clean without noticing the collision. Put to the owner as a three-way choice; owner chose to narrow the block. blocked_areas is now exporters/export_*.py, exporters/derive.py, exporters/refresh.py, site/** — no surface widened, since allowed_areas still refuses any unnamed exporters file. No acceptance criterion or design decision changed.
scope_guard ok on 7 paths after both rounds; manifest re-synced from the main checkout twice (once after the blocked_areas correction, once after round 1 was recorded in the PBI file)

The repaired AC-SV2 test surfaced a real defect round 1 had not found: CPython sets request_version only after its 505 and bad-version-400 checks, so it is still HTTP/0.9 when send_error runs and the base class suppresses the status line and every header — the 505 returned a bare 'bad request' with no Content-Type, Content-Length, Cache-Control or nosniff. _respond_plain now forces HTTP/1.1 in that state. Round 2 confirmed all six framework paths return a proper status line and 9 headers, and that an HTTP/0.9 request gets headers = {} in CPython 3.14 so it cannot pass the Host gate: such a client receives 403 and never any board data.

Round 2 re-measured rather than trusting the change-report: instrumented queue.Queue.put_nowait recorded 2 queue.Full events where round 1 recorded 0; an unbounded queue fails both tests; the watcher-race probe went from clients=1/alive=False/0 refreshes to alive=True/11 refreshes with the change delivered; each of the eight named fixes was mutated back and its test failed without it.

Re-verified independently in both rounds: 127.0.0.1/AF_INET with allow_reuse_address=False; six-method funnel; zero echo of Host, Origin, method token or request line across an 8-case sweep, in body and headers; no Access-Control-Allow-*; query_only=1 with file bytes, mtime, data_version and sqlite_master unchanged; AC-SV7 clean on snapshot and stream; no reset loop.
334 / 99 / 261 PASS, bound to 270f2de; re-run after the rebase onto main a23afd8 so the report attests the tree that merges, not the pre-PBI-011 base
